purpose: Joint lighting/wall model adequacy and constructive ambiguity witnesses; not an automatic correction or accuracy qualification

direct_lane.observation: Direct continuum point samples; no production sampler or optical-width estimate
direct_lane.claim: Each recorded physical fit is a constructive witness at one supplied geometry; this finite grid does not enclose all compatible geometries

image_lane.claim: Actual local two-step fits with supplied true band/optical sigma; true fixed tone is an oracle ablation, not a deployable estimate

exact_ambiguity.claim: A wall matching the top at e and a wall matching paper at e+w give the same flat source field with different silhouette positions

limitations: All observations are synthetic development data, with fixed Gaussian optics and known band width
Illustrative light-level bounds are supplied scenarios, not measured camera noise or physical uncertainty
Least-squares fitting supplies witnesses; absence of a witness at a grid point is not a proof of infinity-norm infeasibility
Five source-node levels bound the source everywhere but do not model a sloped wall, arbitrary light fields, tone errors or non-Gaussian optics
No segmentation, sheet detection, pose, pooled-tone estimation, ring smoothing, parallax, curve fitting, CAD export or physical acceptance is qualified
